Subject: TidalCare AWS co-sell intro + proposed launch cadence (quick ask)

Hi Alyssa —

Quick note to request a warm intro to the TidalCare buying group (Jordan + Priyanka copied below) so we can kick off an AWS co-sell/marketplace conversation. TidalCare is piloting generative search and clinical summarization and we believe Redwood's Dedicated + Marketplace listing will help them scale with predictable latency and procurement-friendly billing.

Two asks:
- Can you introduce us to the AWS account team who owns TidalCare and confirm whether they'll join a joint kickoff call next week?
- If AWS is open, we want to run a short joint-account play: 30–45 min bridge call to align stakeholders, then a 2-week technical sprint (demo + security checklist) leading to a marketplace listing intake.

I've proposed draft MAP and a short tech summary attached — these are intentionally sparse so we can adapt to AWS / customer asks. If you can route an intro and confirm preferred times for a bridge call (Wed/Thu 11:00–14:00 PT preferred), that would be great.

Thanks — appreciate your help here.

Best,
Grace O'Connor
Head of GTM Partnerships (marketplace)
Redwood Inference

Hi Grace —

Thanks for the context and the MAP. I'm looping in Jordan and Priyanka from TidalCare and also copying in the AWS field rep on their account (internal). Jordan/Priyanka — happy to coordinate a short bridge call next week to confirm scope and whether the AWS account team will pursue a co-sell.

Jordan/Priyanka — can you share a couple of 30–45 minute windows that work (PT) and any procurement/security leads we should include?

Grace/Dylan/Karthik/Laura — quick note from AWS side: for co-sell + marketplace push we'll want to validate: marketplace listing owner, procurement cadence (invoice vs marketplace metering), and an initial security questionnaire. If you can have a concise version of the security answers ready, that will speed things.

Cheers,

Hi Jordan + Priyanka —

Great to meet you (virtually). I'm Dylan, Redwood's AE on this opportunity — thanks Alyssa and Grace for pulling this together. Attached is a very short mutual-action plan (same file Grace shared, v1) but here's the one-page ask so we can be efficient on the bridge call:

Objectives (what success looks like):
- Joint AWS/Redwood pilot approved for 60 clinician seats, 3m trial, with marketplace billing option evaluated by procurement.
- Demo that proves 99th percentile latency below 250ms for clinical search flows.
- Security sign-off on data-at-rest encryption & SOC2 evidence.

Proposed 2-week runway:
1) Bridge call (30–45m): stakeholders + AWS field rep — align scope & deadlines.
2) Week 1: Technical walkthrough + sample dataset test (Redwood to run on Dedicated infra).
3) Week 2: Procurement check + marketplace intake form submission.

Roles & asks:
- TidalCare: provide procurement contact and a short security contact + sample dataset (anonymized).
- AWS: confirm account engagement and preferred billing path.
- Redwood: provide demo, latency report, and security artifacts (SOC2 excerpt).

Suggested times for bridge call (PT):
- Tue 2026-12-08 11:00–11:45
- Wed 2026-12-09 13:00–13:45
- Thu 2026-12-10 12:00–12:45

Attachments: tidalcare-ma-plan-v1.pdf, redwood-aws-tech-summary.pdf

If any of these slots work, Jordan/Priyanka please pick one and we'll send a calendar invite with an agenda.

—Dylan
Dylan Brooks
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
dylan_brooks@redwood.com

Hi all — thanks for the clear plan. Wed 2026-12-09 13:00 PT works best for our team.

A couple of notes up front to make the bridge call productive:
- Procurement: please include our procurement lead, Priyanka (cc'ed). We have a preferred vendor flow and need to understand if marketplace metering will satisfy our capital approval (we typically require net-30 after pilot).
- Security: we're dealing with de-identified clinical notes; SOC2 + encryption at rest are minimums. We will send a short security checklist prior to the call.

Jordan Reyes
